instruction: Disable VLC's global play/pause hotkey to prevent accidental activation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's global play/pause hotkey by clearing the global-key-play-pause setting in the config file. The evaluator uses the existing check_global_key_play_pause metric function which checks if the setting is empty (returns '0') or has a value (returns '1'). Expected value is 0 (disabled). The get_vlc_config getter reads the VLC config file and the metric verifies the hotkey is disabled. No new functions needed - reusing existing VLC evaluation infrastructure.
metadata.similarity_to_original: Very similar - both tasks involve changing a single VLC preference setting. Original disables splash cone icon, this disables global hotkey.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads VLC config file from OS-specific location using get_vlc_config
Metric logic correctly checks if global-key-play-pause setting is empty (disabled=0) or has value (enabled=1)
Expected value correctly set to 0 to verify hotkey is disabled
Complete coverage: instruction requires disabling global hotkey, evaluator checks exactly that requirement
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are reflected
Metric parameter handling is correct: accesses rule['expected_global_key_play_pause'] directly from rules dict
Runtime feasibility: config file will exist after VLC launch, getter can access it from VM
Logic handles edge cases: defaults to '0' if setting not found in config file
